_comment: Hero copy — source of truth. deploy.sh:apply_copy rewrites the hero object of every language block in site/index.html and site/GeorgeAI.dc.html from this file on every deploy, so a re-export from the design tool cannot silently revert it. Wedge: missed enquiries (phone + web form) answered, qualified and booked 24/7. Keep it to that one wedge — the other services live on /services/. Proof claims must stay inside what the site can back: 8+ years, 40+ projects, 15+ technologies, five languages, ~2-week pilot. Mirror any message change into seo/noscript.html, which is what crawlers and AI engines read.

en.eyebrow: For owner-run trades, clinics and service firms in Germany
en.title: The enquiry you miss on a Saturday still ends up in your calendar.
en.sub: An AI voice agent picks up the phone and an assistant answers on your website — day or night, in the caller's own language — every enquiry qualified and booked in. 8+ years, 40+ projects delivered, five languages — your pilot goes live in about two weeks.

de.eyebrow: Für Handwerk, Praxen und Dienstleister im Mittelstand
de.title: Der Anruf, den Sie samstags verpassen, steht montags in Ihrem Kalender.
de.sub: Ein KI-Assistent geht ans Telefon und antwortet auf Ihrer Website — Tag und Nacht, in der Sprache des Kunden: Anliegen notiert, Termin gebucht. 8+ Jahre Erfahrung, 40+ Projekte, fünf Sprachen — nach rund zwei Wochen läuft Ihr Pilotprojekt.

fr.eyebrow: Pour les artisans, cabinets et PME de services en Allemagne
fr.title: L'appel manqué du samedi soir finit quand même dans votre agenda.
fr.sub: Un agent vocal IA décroche, un assistant répond sur votre site — jour et nuit, dans la langue du client — chaque demande arrive qualifiée dans votre agenda. 8+ ans d'expérience, 40+ projets, cinq langues. Votre pilote démarre en deux semaines environ.

ro.eyebrow: Pentru patroni din Germania — ateliere, clinici și firme de servicii
ro.title: Clientul care sună sâmbăta, când nu răspunde nimeni, vă apare tot în calendar.
ro.sub: Un agent vocal AI vă preia apelurile, iar un asistent răspunde pe site — zi și noapte, în limba clientului — fiecare cerere ajunge calificată în calendar. 8+ ani de experiență, 40+ proiecte, cinci limbi — pilotul intră în funcțiune în circa două săptămâni.

ar.eyebrow: لأصحاب الورش والعيادات وشركات الخدمات في ألمانيا
ar.title: الاستفسار الذي يفوتك يوم السبت يصبح موعدًا في جدولك.
ar.sub: وكيل صوتي بالذكاء الاصطناعي يردّ على هاتفك، ومساعد يردّ على موقعك — ليلًا ونهارًا وبلغة العميل — فيؤهّل كل استفسار ويحجز له موعدًا في جدولك. أكثر من 8 سنوات خبرة، وما يزيد على 40 مشروعًا، وخمس لغات — ونظامك التجريبي يدخل الخدمة خلال أسبوعين تقريبًا.
